summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a PDMR transaction – the President, US acquired 8.572 notional ADS at $55.70 per share within the Executive Supplemental Savings Plan. No deal terms, no strategic event, no board action beyond routine disclosure under UK Market Abuse Regulation via SEC 6-K. This is an ordinary equity transaction by a company insider, not a special situation. Equivalent to a U.S. Form 4 filing. No further analysis warranted.
